response.sql: WITH qc_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_projects FROM qc_counts), shares AS (SELECT qc_counts.arcref, qc_counts.count, CAST(qc_counts.count AS REAL) / totals.total_count as share, CAST(qc_counts.count AS REAL) / totals.total_count - 1.0 / totals.num_projects as deviation FROM qc_counts CROSS JOIN totals) SELECT arcref, count, share, deviation FROM shares ORDER BY deviation DESC, arcref ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Average share across projects is interpreted as the arithmetic mean: 1 / (count of distinct projects in scanqc). This equals the sum of all shares divided by the number of projects, which is always 1/num_projects.
Only projects that have at least one QC record in scanqc are included; projects in the projects table with no QC records are excluded.
